form:FormGroup.label: Destination Type
form:FormGroup.helpText: Where notifications are sent. Stream writes them to a feed in Stroom; Email sends them to the recipients you enter.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Stream writes to a feed; Email sends to recipients.

form:FormGroup.label: Enabled
form:FormGroup.helpText: Whether this notification is sent. Untick it to stop sending without losing its settings. Default is ticked.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Untick to stop sending this notification.

form:FormGroup.label: Limit Notifications
form:FormGroup.helpText: Stop sending once Maximum Notifications have been sent. Sending starts again after the Resume Notifications After period, or when Stroom restarts. Default is unticked.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Stops sending after Maximum Notifications is reached.

form:FormGroup.label: Maximum Notifications
form:FormGroup.helpText: Number of notifications to send before sending stops, from 1 to 1000. Only used when Limit Notifications is ticked. Default is 1.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: 1 to 1000. Used only when Limit Notifications is ticked.

form:FormGroup.label: Resume Notifications After
form:FormGroup.helpText: How long to wait after the last notification before sending starts again, once the limit has been reached. Only used when Limit Notifications is ticked. Default is 1 Days.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Wait before sending resumes. Used only when Limit Notifications is ticked.
